module.Title: Cave Facility Automation Capstone
module.Teaching: Combine functions, safety logic, modes, sensors, equipment records, repeated monitoring, and logging into one controller.
module.ExampleCode:
def can_start(level_ok, emergency_stop):
    return level_ok and not emergency_stop
module.TargetCode:
def can_start(mode, door_closed, level_ok, emergency_stop):
    return mode == "AUTO" and door_closed and level_ok and not emergency_stop

def log_event(message):
    with open("facility.log", "a") as file:
        file.write(message + "\n")

mode = "AUTO"
door_closed = True
level_ok = True
emergency_stop = False
pump_running = False

if can_start(mode, door_closed, level_ok, emergency_stop):
    pump_running = True
    log_event("Pump started")
    for cycle in range(1, 4):
        if emergency_stop:
            pump_running = False
            log_event("Emergency stop")
            break
        print(f"Monitoring cycle {cycle}")
else:
    log_event("Start blocked")
